opening.argument: The offer is presented as a conditional promotional reward, with its material requirements disclosed on the access page. The title advertises a "free $50 Panera Bread Gift Card for US Citizens," and the description directs viewers to "Get Access here: http://clkti.com/6jMh." The displayed page identifies the offer as a $50 Panera Bread gift card while expressly stating "Participation and Purchases Required," providing an email-entry field and a Continue button. It also directs viewers to the access link in the description. These details show that participation and purchases are conditions of the offer, so the prominent "free" wording must be read with those disclosed terms. The evidence does not establish that a no-cost card is guaranteed, but neither does it establish that the conditional promotion is fraudulent.
